time_origin: first event timestamp of independent sequence, explicitly passed to reset
output_policy: publish only after watermark reaches right boundary; discard final partial window

C2-LMEC.background: mean count of 8 adjacent cells in same bin

training.loss: prototype max then two-class softmax BCE

selection: On Train-dev exact-int8: retain points with Pd >= C0 Pd - 0.005 and Fa <= 1.10*C0 Fa at the same threshold; rank by IoU, then AP, high-density Recall, lower Fa, earlier epoch. Report fixed 0.40 separately.
reserved_data_rule: No Validation/Test reads before candidate, threshold, quantization and hashes are frozen. No retuning after reserved-data evaluation.
